clue.text: Arthur's best man!

parts.note: reads like a wedding's best man, but means the finest and purest of King Arthur's knights of the Round Table

explanation.definitionFit: Galahad was the purest knight of King Arthur's court, the one who achieved the Holy Grail.

clue.text: Vulgarly dismiss what the old wine waiter might have suggested?

definitions.meaning: to fire someone from a job, in slang

definitions.text: what the old wine waiter might have suggested?
definitions.meaning: an old name for a dry white wine such as sherry, which a waiter of long ago might have recommended

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for firing an employee, and also the historical name for fortified white wines imported from Spain.

clue.text: Letting something out

parts.note: reads like releasing an object or a secret, but means letting out a property to a tenant for money

explanation.definitionFit: Letting out a flat or house means leasing it to tenants in return for payment.

clue.text: Helps tear the stable apart, a pound having been lost

indicators.note: with apart, tear means rip to pieces, so the letters of the word are rearranged
completes the instruction to pull the word to bits and rebuild it
says the pound sign letter goes missing from the word before shuffling

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone helpfully wrecks a stable, losing a pound in the process.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having been lost' takes L out of STABLE, leaving STABE, and 'tear ... apart' rearranges those letters; 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To abet is to help or encourage someone, usually in wrongdoing, so this is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Those who want the rest to be in an unconscious state

definitions.text: Those who want the rest to be in an unconscious state

parts.words: Those who want the rest to be in an unconscious state
parts.note: people wanting a rest want to be, in a punning phrase, at slumber; the word describes being unconscious in sleep

explanation.definitionFit: Being sound asleep is the everyday unconscious state of resting at night.

clue.text: Dog the last in motoring organisation chaos

indicators.note: chaos puts the letters of the preceding words into disorder

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British breakdown and motoring club

explanation.surface: A dog causes havoc for the latest arrival at a motoring club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chaos' rearranges LASTIN together with AA; 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alsatian is the British name for the German Shepherd breed of dog.

clue.text: It may burn liquid

parts.note: describes a corrosive fluid that can burn skin, as in a chemistry lab

explanation.definitionFit: Strong corrosive liquids from chemistry can burn flesh and metal on contact.

clue.text: Worker whose face is his fortune? His livelihood, anyway!

definitions.text: Worker whose face is his fortune? His livelihood, anyway!

parts.words: Worker whose face is his fortune? His livelihood, anyway!
parts.note: plays on the saying about a pretty face being one's fortune; here the face is the coal face where a miner earns his living

explanation.definitionFit: A coal miner works at the coal face, so the face is literally his means of making money.

clue.text: Designed for those who want to clean chemicals

definitions.text: Designed for those who want to clean chemicals

parts.words: Designed for those who want to clean chemicals
parts.note: describes cleaning agents, chemical products made for people wanting to wash things

explanation.definitionFit: Cleaning agents used for washing clothes and dishes are chemical compounds sold to clean with.

clue.text: Closely study various lace and hide

parts.note: to con is an old word meaning to study or learn carefully

indicators.note: various suggests the letters of the next word are set in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone peers at assorted lace and then hides it away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'various' rearranges LACE into CEAL; 'and' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To conceal is to hide something from view, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Drunk in a large room-it brings tears to your eyes!

definitions.text: it brings tears to your eyes

indicators.note: in places the room inside the word for a drunkard

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunkard
a hall is a large room for gatherings

explanation.surface: A drunk in a big hall weeps at something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a' is a link; the chopping of this small onion is what makes eyes water.
explanation.definitionFit: Like other onions, a small shallot releases a compound when cut that makes the eyes stream.

clue.text: Have a word, meaning to be pleasant

definitions.text: Have a word, meaning to be pleasant

parts.words: Have a word, meaning to be pleasant
parts.note: plays on the word's Latin root meaning able to be spoken to: a friendly person is easy to have a word with

explanation.definitionFit: A friendly, approachable person is easy to talk to, which is what the Latin source of the word meant.

clue.text: Police officer has nothing right away to check

indicators.note: away sends the pieces just named out of the officer's title

parts.note: an inspector is a rank of police officer
O is the round figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A police officer with no right to act checks something anyway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' and 'to' are links; removing O and R from the rank leaves the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect something is to examine or check it closely.

clue.text: Fair exchange, right for a religious man

indicators.note: exchange swaps the letters of the word around

explanation.surface: A fair swap is arranged on behalf of a clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchange' rearranges FAIR into FRIA; 'for a' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A friar is a man belonging to a religious order such as the Franciscans.

clue.text: Group of workers do business with Mr. Lincoln's group

parts.note: to trade is to buy and sell, do business
Abraham Lincoln led the Union, the northern states in the American Civil War

explanation.surface: Workers trade with Abraham Lincoln's party.
explanation.definitionFit: A labour organisation of employees banded together to bargain over pay and conditions.

clue.text: Observe with good feeling?

definitions.meaning: to look at or watch closely
esteem or affection felt for someone

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to look at something, and also high esteem, as in kind wishes.

clue.text: Cuts off the pork supplies

parts.note: reads like stopping deliveries of meat, but means slices cut off a side of bacon

explanation.definitionFit: Thin slices of bacon, cut from cured pork, are the breakfast slices in question.

clue.text: Major sweet producer out to get the Scouts together

definitions.text: Major sweet producer out to get the Scouts together

parts.words: Major sweet producer out to get the Scouts together
parts.note: the opening suggests a confectioner, but the phrase points to a large rally of Scouts

explanation.definitionFit: A large international gathering of Boy Scouts is called by this name.

clue.text: Right! Tire out on the day before and get back

indicators.note: out suggests the word is disordered and its letters rearranged

parts.note: eve is the day before an event

explanation.surface: Someone tires on the eve and wants to return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges TIRE into ETRI; 'on' and 'and' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrieve something is to fetch it or get it back again.

clue.text: The rest said confusion causes catastrophe

indicators.note: confusion mixes up the letters of the words before it

explanation.surface: Confusion over what everyone else said leads to ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: A disaster is a sudden calamity, directly synonymous with catastrophe.

clue.text: Bearing smoked fish for the captain

parts.note: S is the compass bearing south
a kipper is a smoked herring

explanation.surface: A ship's master is known for smoked fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A skipper is the captain of a ship or of a sports team.

clue.text: Hide me in furniture that conceals the curtain rod

definitions.text: furniture that conceals the curtain rod

indicators.note: in puts the word for oneself inside the animal skin

parts.note: a pelt is an animal hide
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone asks to be hidden in a piece of furniture over the curtains.
explanation.definitionFit: A pelmet is a narrow board or fabric strip fitted above a window to hide the curtain fittings.

clue.text: Result of a mix-up in the breeding

definitions.text: Result of a mix-up in the breeding

parts.words: Result of a mix-up in the breeding
parts.note: describes a dog of mixed parentage rather than a single pedigree

explanation.definitionFit: A dog of no definite breed, born of mixed ancestry, is called this.

clue.text: Impression produced as a result of action ?

definitions.meaning: the impact something makes on an audience
the outcome or consequence of a cause

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the impression made on the senses and the consequence of a cause.

clue.text: Get together to arrange one tune. .

indicators.note: to arrange is to put the letters into a new order, as in music arranging

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Musicians meet to arrange a single tune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrange' rearranges I with TUNE; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To unite is to join together into one body or group.

clue.text: .And forbear to have a chorus

definitions.meaning: to hold back from doing something
a repeated line or section of a song

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to abstain from an action, and also the repeated part of a song.

clue.text: The devil drives a beast of burden to a point of deadlock

parts.note: an imp is a little devil
an ass is a donkey, a classic pack animal
E is the compass point east

explanation.surface: A devil drives a donkey towards a standstill.
explanation.definitionFit: An impasse is a situation where no progress is possible, a deadlock.

clue.text: Clever saying it's sarcastic

parts.note: describes a short witty remark, often with a satirical sting

explanation.definitionFit: An epigram is a pithy, witty saying, often pointed or satirical.

clue.text: African, losing a string, nevertheless played to a hot accompaniment!

definitions.text: nevertheless played to a hot accompaniment

indicators.note: losing tells us a letter drops out of the word

parts.note: the dated, now offensive term for a Black African, used in this old clue
G is one of the strings of a violin

explanation.surface: An African loses a string but plays on to a fiery backing.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition recalls the legend that the emperor fiddled while Rome burned; the clue's word for African is a dated, now offensive term.
explanation.definitionFit: Legend says the Roman emperor played music while Rome burned, the hot accompaniment.

clue.text: Champion rep, valuable to a publishing house

parts.note: best means champion, top
a sales rep is a seller

explanation.surface: A top sales rep is an asset to a publisher.
explanation.definitionFit: A book that sells in great numbers earns a publisher a lot of money.
